title: Talking about celebrations
summary: Use the lemma in brackets. Greetings use з/із/зі plus the instrumental; до takes the genitive.

holiday-inst.sentenceGloss: Our friends congratulated us on the holiday.
holiday-inst.note: Instrumental: привітати зі takes the instrumental.

christmas-gen.sentenceGloss: There is one week left until Christmas.

easter-gen.sentenceGloss: Traditional bread is prepared for Easter.

tradition-inst.sentenceGloss: This custom became a family tradition.
tradition-inst.note: Instrumental: the instrumental names what the custom became.

present-inst.sentenceGloss: The child is happy about the new robot: it was an unexpected present.
present-inst.note: Instrumental: the instrumental names what the robot turned out to be.

pysanka-inst.sentenceGloss: We admired the decorated Easter egg with a geometric design.
pysanka-inst.note: Instrumental: the instrumental names what was admired.

carol-inst.sentenceGloss: The performance began with a Christmas carol.
carol-inst.note: Instrumental: the instrumental names what the performance began with.

uzvar-inst.sentenceGloss: A jug of dried-fruit drink stood on the table.
uzvar-inst.note: Instrumental: the instrumental names what the jug was filled with.
